description: What size portable dehumidifier you need, in pints per day, from the ENERGY STAR chart for your space size and how damp it is, with a liters and gallons conversion. Formula: Pick the ENERGY STAR range for the condition and size (under or over 2,000 sq ft), then take the top of the range, or the water your current unit removes per day if that is higher. Liters = pints × 0.4732; gallons = pints ÷ 8.

condition.description: Condition without a dehumidifier; default very

pints_emptied_per_day.description: Water you empty now, if replacing a unit (optional) (pints/day); default 0

name: calc_dehumidifier_size
title: Dehumidifier Size Calculator (Pints per Day by Room Size)
